versions.changelog:
Initial release of laopaidang-core (nomos-core) skill:

- Provides a core, loadable specification for collaborative partner (拍档) agents following the Nomos Group AI Skill Standard v1.
- Fully multilingual: supports input/output in 8 major languages (zh-CN, en, ja, ko, es, fr, de, ar), with automatic language detection and same-language reply.
- Implements MedXpert governance, incorporating unique AI Passport Regime identity, A³ Laws, XCGS governance, and cross-industry compliance frameworks.
- Designed for expandability to additional languages and extensible to more regulatory requirements.
- Released under the MIT License by SynomosAI.
